# MaskIN sample documents and use cases

**SAMPLE – FAKE DATA.** Every name, address, phone number, Aadhaar, PAN, IFSC, UPI ID and account number in this folder is made up. The Aadhaar numbers were generated by code so that they pass the Verhoeff checksum; they do not belong to anyone.

How to use a sample:
- `.txt` files: open the file, copy all the text, and paste it into ChatGPT's message box. `01_kyc_letters.txt` is the same content as `01_kyc_letters.pdf`, ready to paste (best for the live demo).
- `.pdf` and `.png` files: open the MaskIN side panel and drop the file on the **Document** area, then click **Insert masked text into ChatGPT**.

Then click **Mask** (or press Option+Shift+M), check the Review popup, click **Apply mask**, add the question below and press Send.

| # | File | Ask ChatGPT | What MaskIN should hide | What stays visible |
|---|------|-------------|-------------------------|--------------------|
| 1 | `01_kyc_letters.pdf` (text PDF, 10 letters, English and Hindi names) | "Make a table of every name, address and phone number." | 10 names (8 English, 2 Devanagari), 10 addresses, 10 phone numbers, 10 Aadhaar numbers | Letter text, KYC status |
| 2 | `02_salary_slip.pdf` (text PDF) | "Calculate my income tax for this year under the new regime." | Employee name, PAN, bank account number, employer address | Salary, allowances, deductions (needed for the maths) |
| 3 | `03_rent_agreement.txt` | "Summarise this agreement and list anything unfair to the tenant." | Landlord and tenant names, both addresses, both Aadhaar and PAN numbers, tenant's phone | Rent, deposit, clauses |
| 4 | `04_bank_statement.txt` | "Explain these charges and total my UPI spends." | Account holder name and address, account number, IFSC, mobile, all UPI IDs | Every amount and date |
| 5 | `05_failed_transaction.txt` | "Write a complaint email to my bank about this failed payment." | Name, account number, IFSC, UPI IDs (own and landlord's), phone, email, address | Amount, dates, complaint number |
| 6 | `06_form_photo.png` (photo of a filled form, read by OCR) | "Turn this form into a clean typed summary." | Name, father's name, date of birth, Aadhaar, PAN, mobile, email, address | Account type |
| 7 | `07_marathi_letter_scanned.pdf` (image-only scan, Marathi, read by OCR) | "Translate this letter into English and explain what it asks for." | Devanagari names (सुनीता पाटील, अनिल पाटील), address, Aadhaar (Devanagari digits), mobile | Income amount, office name, subject |
| 8 | `08_hospital_bill.txt` | "Check if the claim amount on this bill is correct." | Patient name, date of birth, address, phone, policy holder name | Every bill amount and the diagnosis |

Notes:
- Names and addresses are found by Gemma running locally in Ollama. If Ollama is off, MaskIN still hides the IDs and numbers (regex-only mode) and says so in the popup.
- After ChatGPT replies, the fakes in the answer turn back into the real values on your screen, with a dotted underline and a "MaskIN: N restored" badge. Click **Show what ChatGPT saw** to see the fake version.
- Merchant UPI handles such as `swiggy@ybl` are also detected as UPI IDs. Untick them in the Review popup if you want ChatGPT to see the merchant names.
